game.name: Pokemon Red Version
game.desc: Begin your journey in Pallet Town with Charmander, Squirtle, or Bulbasaur, battle the 8 Kanto Gym Leaders, defeat Team Rocket, and become the Indigo Plateau Pokemon League Champion!

game.name: Pokemon Blue Version
game.desc: Explore the Kanto region, catch and train 151 original Pokemon, challenge Rival Blue and the Elite Four, and complete Professor Oak's Pokedex!

game.name: Pokemon Yellow Version: Special Pikachu Edition
game.desc: Partner with Pikachu walking right behind you across Kanto, earn all three starter Pokemon (Bulbasaur, Charmander, Squirtle), and battle Jessie & James of Team Rocket!
